title: [Bug]: UPF HA - PDU session is not released/established in CM_IDLE

body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.6.4

### Steps to reproduce

1. 2 UPFs associate with SMF
2. UE registers and establishes a PDU session using UPF1
3. UE enters CM_IDLE state
4. UPF1 is killed

The scenario for CM_CONNECTED state (without step 3) has already been addressed in [Support for UPF HA - release/establish new PDU session](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/commit/af07cc75ec0d1b245d4620c69d3a20ea01f57cf2) and [Follow-up on !2048](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/commit/b6aa3aba5bc7098853afd3eb7f0e803fa7471be1).

### Logs

[UpfHaIdle_v2.6.4_bug.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/11944647/UpfHaIdle_v2.6.4_bug.zip)

### Expected behaviour

PDU session is reestablished using UPF2.

![UPF_HA_IDLE_flow_fix](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/assets/93838663/616e074f-3a21-4a54-93f3-24463d94a20a)


### Observed Behaviour

PDU session is not reestablished using UPF2

PDU Session Release Command:(Reactivation requested) is not transferred to the UE.

1. If no Uplink Data Status is present: Service request is just Accepted
![UPF_HA_IDLE_UERANSIM_flow_bug](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/assets/93838663/39a1e928-3146-4651-aa5f-b0f8fe1f54df)

2. If Uplink Data Status is present: ACTIVATING is just confirmed on crashed UPF1
![UPF_HA_IDLE_IXIA_flow_bug](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/assets/93838663/f18d4a9e-7430-4416-a153-8f4d3dbbbac7)


### eNodeB/gNodeB

1. UERANSIM, 2. IXIA

### UE Models and versions

1. UERANSIM, 2. IXIA
